definition: VGT3 is an Amazon facility in Las Vegas used for data harvesting and destructive book scanning to train large language models.
details: Employees at VGT3 receive the books, cut their spines, and scan their pages, destroying the books in the process.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. And that is VGT3 — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
